🚨 80% of cloud environments now run MCP servers. But security adoption hasn't caught up.

Wiz Research looked into exposed MCP servers across the web and found unauthenticated endpoints returning real production data, internal records, and IAM write actions.

The numbers behind the gap 👇
• 1 in 6 environments expose at least one MCP server
• 70% return their full tool schema to anonymous callers
• 42% return real data when a tool is called
• Almost all run pre-March 2025 specs without built-in auth

The fix is preventive: gate tool execution behind OAuth 2.1, scope backend credentials to least privilege, and enable prompt logging for AI agents.

posts.content:
🚨 GhostApproval: We tested 6 AI coding assistants. What we found changed how we think about AI security.

Our Wiz Research team uncovered #GhostApproval, a new vulnerability pattern affecting 6 major AI coding assistants.

The idea behind these tools is simple: the AI suggests a change, and you approve it.

But what happens when the approval screen doesn't show what's actually happening?

By abusing a decades-old technique, symbolic links, we found cases where AI agents could access files outside their workspace, while the user saw a harmless looking confirmation prompt.

The lesson? Human-in-the-loop only works when humans have the full picture.

Huge thanks to the vendors who worked with us to fix these issues. 🔍

Read the full research: https://lnkd.in/gkdXWNTG
